scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Purchase of Spectacles, Denture, Hearing Aid (CBOCWWB)
other_conditions: The beneficiary must be working in an establishment and registered under the Punjab Labour Welfare Fund Act, 1965 with regular contribution to the labour welfare fund.
The applicant must have been a member of the Chandigarh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board for at least 6 months before applying.

The financial assistance is granted only on the prescription of a Government Medical Officer/Chief Medical Officer/Principal Medical Officer of any Government Institute in the tri‑city region and is limited to once in a lifetime.
The application must be submitted within one year of eligibility together with all required documents.
Beneficiaries who are covered under ESIC are not eligible for the assistance.
benefits_summary: Provides up to ₹1500 for spectacles, ₹5000 for dentures, and ₹4000 for hearing aids to eligible workers.
documents_required: Clear picture of both sides of the Aadhaar Card
Clear picture of the Bank Passbook
Clear picture of all pages filled on the BOCW Copy issued by the Board
